visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a warning screen featuring a prominent red glowing triangle with an exclamation mark on a black background. Chinese text warnings appear above and below the symbol. The lighting is dark with sharp red neon borders, setting an alert-based tone for the content to follow. (2) A multi-panel layout appears: the top shows a detailed anime character with dark hair; the middle displays a colorful mobile game interface with red lanterns and cityscapes; the bottom shows a young man wearing a black mask and a black shirt. He is sitting in a room with a bed visible behind him. (3) The man interacts with the game interface, his hands appearing with blue energy overlays. He reacts to receiving multiple green frog items within the gacha system. His expressions shift from hope to frustration as he looks into the camera and gestures animatedly while talking about the results. (4) He briefly shows a screenshot of his social media profile while talking. The video then transitions into a comedic sequence where he sings with his hands together before suddenly shouting and making aggressive hand gestures toward the camera. Anime reaction shots are intercut briefly to emphasize the humor. (5) The final phase displays a rock-paper-scissors game on screen followed by a last gacha pull. Upon seeing another frog item reveal, the man reacts with extreme disappointment, slumping back in his chair and covering his face in despair against the background of his bedroom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with high-frequency alarm beeps and electronic buzzing, lasting only a second. There is no vocal activity or background music at this stage. The sound is clean and sharp, clearly designed to grab the listener's immediate attention. (2) A male voice enters, speaking Mandarin with a casual tone and moderate pitch. A low-volume, upbeat electronic background music track begins, featuring a steady percussive beat. Frequent high-pitched digital sound effects signify rewards being revealed in the game interface. (3) The speaker's volume increases as he becomes more expressive, using varied intonation and occasional shouting. The electronic BGM continues at a consistent tempo. Rapid-fire digital UI sound effects are layered over the speech, creating a dense and energetic acoustic atmosphere. (4) The voice transitions into a melodic singing style for a few seconds before switching abruptly to a high-arousal shout with aggressive vocal texture. The BGM remains in the background, but the vocal prominence is significantly higher during this emotional burst. (5) A rhythmic chanting of 'Rock Paper Scissors' is heard, synchronized with the BGM's beat. Following a final reward sound effect, the voice drops to a low-arousal sigh of disappointment. The music gradually fades out into a brief period of studio silence.
